transactions.desc: The Rangers designated Gonzales for assignment Saturday.
The Rangers reinstated Junis (thigh) from the 15-day injured list Saturday.
The  Athletics traded INF Jonathan Ornelas to the Milwaukee Brewers.
The Angels optioned Peralta to Triple-A Salt Lake following Friday's game against the Royals.
The Angels selected Fulmer's contract from Triple-A Salt Lake on Saturday.
The Brewers designated Bae for assignment Saturday, Adam McCalvy of MLB.com reports.
The Mariners claimed Watson off waivers from Detroit on Saturday and optioned him to Triple-A Tacoma.
The Guardians optioned Aleman to Triple-A Columbus on Saturday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.
The Rays optioned Roycroft to Triple-A Durham on Saturday.
The Rays recalled Boyle from Triple-A Durham on Saturday.
The Angels claimed Martin off waivers from the Rays on Saturday and optioned him to Triple-A Salt Lake.
The Blue Jays designated Estrada for assignment Saturday, Mitch Bannon of The Athletic reports.
The Blue Jays selected Cameron's contract from Triple-A Buffalo on Saturday, Mitch Bannon of The Athletic reports.
The Blue Jays optioned Lee to Triple-A Buffalo on Saturday.
The Blue Jays recalled Tiedemann from Triple-A Buffalo on Saturday.
The Cardinals optioned Prieto to Triple-A Memphis on Saturday, Jeff Jones of the Belleville News-Democrat reports.
The Cardinals recalled Baez from Triple-A Memphis on Saturday, Jeff Jones of the Belleville News-Democrat reports.
The White Sox optioned Quero to Triple-A Charlotte on Saturday.
The Rangers designated Curvelo for assignment Friday.
The Rangers selected Gonzales' contract from Triple-A Round Rock on Friday.
The Rangers optioned Peoples to Triple-A Round Rock on Friday.
The Rangers optioned Cauley to Triple-A Round Rock on Friday.
The Rangers recalled Freeman from Triple-A Round Rock on Friday.
The Brewers recalled Anderson from Triple-A Nashville on Friday.
Richardson signed a minor-league contract with the Brewers on Friday, Curt Hogg of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.
Leonard was outrighted to Triple-A Sacramento on Friday after clearing waivers, Susan Slusser of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
The Mariners selected Rodden's contract from Triple-A Tacoma on Friday, Adam Jude of The Seattle Times reports.
The Yankees signed Topa to a minor-league contract Friday, Gary Phillips of the New York Daily News reports.
The Blue Jays optioned Estrada to Triple-A Buffalo on Friday.
Hill (oblique) was activated from the 7-day injured list at Double-A Akron on Friday.
